# GApex — GEO Readiness Checker

> GApex is the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) readiness checker for the AI search era. It audits a website across 25 categories and 100+ signals to measure how visible, quotable, and citable the site is to ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Copilot.

GApex helps product teams, marketers, and agencies understand whether their website is discoverable and correctly represented by large language models. A single audit returns an AI Visibility Score (0–100), a category breakdown, and actionable fix recommendations.

## What GApex checks

- **Crawl access**: robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, .well-known manifests, and explicit allow/deny rules for AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and 12 more).
- **Content extractability**: server-side rendering vs. client-side JS, semantic HTML, heading structure, readable text ratio.
- **Meta & structured data**: title, description, Open Graph, Twitter card, JSON-LD Organization/FAQ/HowTo, canonical.
- **Authority signals**: HTTPS, security headers, author attribution, sameAs profile links, cross-platform presence.
- **Answer-format readiness**: FAQ blocks, step-by-step instructions, comparison tables, TL;DR summaries, quotable statistics — content shapes AI models prefer to cite.

## FAQ

### What is GEO?
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of making a website discoverable and quotable by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

### How does GApex work?
GApex runs 100+ checks across 25 categories to produce a 0–100 AI Visibility Score, a category breakdown, and actionable fix recommendations.

### What AI engines does GApex cover?
ChatGPT (GPTBot), Perplexity (PerplexityBot), Claude (ClaudeBot), Google AI Overviews (Google-Extended), Copilot, and more.

### Is there a free plan?
Yes. Register and run 3 basic checks per month at no cost.

## Community

The GApex community is where GEO practitioners — product teams, SEO/AEO specialists, technical marketers, and independent operators — compare audit results, discuss AI-bot policy changes (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), and request features.

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/mJVEVXyxD5) — live chat with the GApex team and other users. Good place to share audit outputs, ask about specific check results, request features, and get help interpreting AI-visibility scores. English and Chinese channels.
- [X / Twitter @zen7_labs](https://x.com/zen7_labs) — product announcements, weekly GEO tips, and notifications when AI crawler policies or algorithms change. Also mirrors new knowledge-base articles.
